messages:
sara: FYI saw increased fncall schema rejects in canary today. tool outputs with extra top-level keys are getting hardened. one example we captured:

 sara: ```json
{"status":"ok","result":{"text":"done"},"trace_id":"abc123","_internal_metadata":{"latency_ms":12}}
```

 sara: validator error: unexpected_properties ["_internal_metadata"] -> we return structured reject and abort.

 max: are unknown properties globally hard-rejecting now?

 kai: last rollout flipped strict-by-default to catch broken tools earlier. fncall expected a per-route lenient path, but the toggle wasnt applied for that tenant.

 liz: @kai can you confirm tenant flag state?

 kai: confirmed tenant used default strict policy.

 max: proposal: for unknown properties switch to softfail (log + metric + allow passthrough) for existing customers for 2w, then enforce strict after notice. reduces customer outages.

 liz: console needs visibility: add reject_count, softfail_count and latest_sample to route detail so support can triage without paging infra.

 max: telemetry plan: emit fncall.reject_rate_by_route, fncall.unknown_prop_softfail and sampled fncall.reject_examples (sanitized). sampling: 1/min/route.

 kai: we must redact PII before storing samples. add ingestion redactor for common keys (email, ssn, ccnum, phone) and truncate long values >1024 chars.

 sara: billing: current hard-reject refunds model tokens but still counts tool call. product wants clearer semantics. suggested: softfails non-billable for tools; hard rejects billed. product to confirm.

 max: add route config fncall.unknown_props_policy with enum strict|permissive|softfail and console toggle for admins. default permissive for legacy tenants, strict for new.

 liz: rollout: enable softfail flag in internal canaries, notify partners, provide migration docs and an opt-in SDK shim to strip _internal_* props. after 30d plan strict enforcement for non-migrated accounts.

 kai: I will change validator to treat unknown_properties as softfail when flag enabled: emit metric fncall.unknown_prop_softfail and continue. opening PR now.

 sara: deploy-bot gate it behind feature flag so we can rollback quickly.

 deploy-bot: feature flag fncall:unknown-props-softfail created (ff-9903). default OFF in prod, ON in canaries internal-dev and canary-1.

 max: ops: watch fncall.reject_rate_by_route and fncall.unknown_prop_softfail. if softfail >> rejects we might be hiding issues; set alert if softfail > 10x rejects for 30m.

 liz: console change: stacked timeline for rejects vs softfails vs passthroughs + drilldown to sampled sanitized example and remediation tips.

 sara: SDK team: add opt-in shim that strips keys starting with _ or named internal* before validation to reduce partner churn.

 kai: will include SDK shim in the PR and mark it opt-in.

 max: actions: kai PR for softfail + metric + SDK shim; liz console widget + docs; product to confirm billing; ops add alerts. rollout: broaden canaries tomorrow, monitor 48h, then widen.

 sara: any objections?

 liz: +1

 max: :thumbsup:

 kai: on it.

 deploy-bot: deployment scheduled 2026-04-03T02:00:00Z to canary clusters.
